text: dsh-anthropic-membership 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的 Claude Pro/Max 订阅接入插件。它在 DSH 的 Anthropic 模型卡片中提供订阅登录，并在本机控制服务和浏览器界面之间同步登录状态。主要功能包括显示五小时及每周用量、统计 DSH 消息和模型调用、缩小请求图片，以及精简上下文压缩请求。适合希望从 DSH 使用 Claude 订阅并了解用量的用户。使用前需要 Claude Pro 或 Max 账户以及本机 DSH 环境；不需要额外配置 Anthropic API Key。

dsh-anthropic-membership connects Claude Pro/Max to the DSH web client. It adds subscription sign-in, usage display, DSH message counts, image resizing, and slimmer context-compaction requests. A Claude Pro or Max account and local DSH installation are required; no Anthropic API key is needed.
我想用 Claude 订阅登录 DSH，不想配置 API Key。
DSH 里能查看 Claude 账户的五小时和每周用量吗？
想知道我在 DSH 这段时间发了多少条消息、调用了多少次模型。
Anthropic 请求里的大图片总被拒绝，能自动缩小吗？
长会话触发压缩时超出上下文限制怎么办？
能在模型设置卡片看到订阅状态和计划用量吗？
Can I sign in to DSH with my Claude Pro or Max membership?
How can I see my Claude plan usage and DSH message counts in one place?
dsh-anthropic-membership 的功能「订阅登录与计划用量」：通过 Anthropic 模型卡片发起 Claude Pro/Max 登录，并展示五小时和每周用量百分比。
dsh-anthropic-membership 的功能「DSH 用量计数」：读取会话事件，在计划窗口内统计用户消息及 Anthropic 模型调用。
dsh-anthropic-membership 的功能「请求图片缩放」：请求读取图片时自动将长边限制到 2000 像素，并按图像类型输出 JPEG 或 WebP。
dsh-anthropic-membership 的功能「压缩请求精简」：自动在上下文压缩调用中移除图片和推理内容，并截短过长文本，减少发送给总结模型的内容。
dsh-anthropic-membership 使用登录令牌向 api.anthropic.com 查询计划用量，并在界面显示账户级用量百分比。

dsh-anthropic-membership README · dsh-anthropic-membership：DeepSeek Harness plugin: **Sign in with Claude Pro/Max**. Uses the same Anthropic membership OAuth grant Claude Code uses (`isSubscription: true`). No Anthropic API key.

It also unblocks two Anthropic-specific lockups that otherwise freeze a long session:

dsh-anthropic-membership README · dsh-anthropic-membership：1. **Many-image 2000px cap** — DSH can store request images with a long edge of 2048px. Anthropic rejects many-image requests above 2000px, and retries keep sending the same history. This plugin downscales request images to a 2000px long edge.
2. **`/compact` over a 1M window** — when the live prompt is already over the model cap, DSH's summarizer replays that same prompt and fails with `Compaction could not produce a useful summary`. This plugin slims compaction calls (drop images and reasoning, truncate huge tool text) so `/compact` can land.

dsh-anthropic-membership README · Install：Requires the `dsh` CLI.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:antonio-mastropaolo/dsh-anthropic-membership
```

From a local checkout:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/antonio-mastropaolo/dsh-anthropic-membership.git
dsh plugin --profile web add file:./dsh-anthropic-membership
```

Restart `dsh web`. Open **Settings → Models**. On the Anthropic card: **Sign in with Claude Pro/Max**. Then pick an `anthropic` / `claude-*` model.

dsh-anthropic-membership README · Install：A compact chip on the main composer dock shows `Claude · 5h N% · wk N% · N msgs`. The Anthropic card shows **plan-window %** (5-hour and weekly) and **DSH message counts** for that window. It does not show remaining messages, tokens, or dollars. Usage % is account-wide (every Claude app); message counts are DSH only.

If the UI is down:

```sh
node login.mjs
node logout.mjs
node usage.mjs
```

dsh-anthropic-membership README · What it writes：- Settings: `llm-pi-ai.providers.anthropic` (no `apiKeyEnv`) in `~/.dsh/settings.yaml`, or `$DSH_SETTINGS` if set. If you launch DSH from Ollama and `~/.ollama/launch/dsh/settings.yaml` exists, that file is used instead.
- Grant: `llm-pi-ai/anthropic` in `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml` (mode 0600). Never logged.

dsh-anthropic-membership README · Control API：Loopback only, `127.0.0.1:8185` (override with `DSH_MEMBERSHIP_PORT`; the Settings button expects 8185).

| Method | Path | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET | `/healthz` | `{ ok: true }` |
| GET | `/status` | `{ signedIn, expiresAt, imageCap, compactionSlim }` — Origin must be the DSH UI if `Origin` is sent |
| POST | `/login` `/logout` | Requires `Origin: http://127.0.0.1:3080` (or `localhost`) and header `x-dsh-membership: 1` |
dsh-anthropic-membership README · Control API：CORS does not reflect arbitrary `Origin`. A missing CSRF header is 403. `/login` is 409 if a login is already in flight.

dsh-anthropic-membership README · Tests：```sh
npm test
```

Needs a DSH install on disk so `sharp` resolves (or set `DSH_NODE_MODULES` to that `node_modules` directory).

dsh-anthropic-membership README · macOS app window (Helixboard-style)：`/Applications/DSH v1.app` opens DeepSeek Harness in a chromeless Chrome `--app` window (same pattern as Helixcode Dashboard v1). It starts `dsh web` if needed and uses the current launch token. Drag it to the Dock for one click.

The composer dock shows **Claude** 5h/weekly %, a **Codex** slot (lights up when an openai-codex grant exists), and a **Full access** switch (sets `permission.defaultPreset` and `/permission danger-full-access` on the live session).
